club: Maples Tech Club (MTC) — Learn it. Build it. Ship it.

questions.question_text: Which keyboard shortcut is used to COPY selected text or a file?
After copying a sentence, which shortcut do you press to PASTE it?
Which key on the keyboard lets you type ALL CAPITAL LETTERS continuously when turned on?
If you accidentally delete a word while typing, which shortcut immediately UNDOES your mistake?
Which shortcut quickly SAVES the document or drawing you are working on?
Which key moves your typing cursor to the NEXT LINE when writing a paragraph?
Which longest key on the bottom row of a keyboard adds a blank space between words?
Which shortcut selects EVERYTHING on the page or inside a folder at once?
Which shortcut CUTS (moves) selected text so you can paste it somewhere else?
While watching a video on YouTube or VLC, pressing the Spacebar usually does what?
Which shortcut opens the PRINT box to print a page or save it as a PDF?
In Word or Google Docs, what does pressing Ctrl + B do to selected text?
In a document editor, which shortcut makes selected text Italic (slanted)?
In a document editor, which shortcut UNDERLINES the selected words?
What is the difference between the Backspace key and the Delete key while typing?
questions.option_a: Both do the exact same thing
questions.option_b: Backspace erases to the left of the cursor; Delete erases to the right of the cursor

questions.question_text: If you want to quickly FIND a specific word on a long webpage or PDF, which shortcut do you press?
Which key at the top-left of the keyboard is commonly pressed to cancel a pop-up or exit full-screen video?
Which function key is the classic shortcut to REFRESH or reload a webpage in a browser?
Which part of a computer looks like a TV screen and shows pictures, videos, and text?
Which hand-held device moves the pointer/arrow across the computer screen?
Which part of the computer is often called the "brain" because it carries out instructions?
Which device lets you hear music, voice calls, or video sound privately without disturbing others in the lab?
What is the small wheel between the left and right buttons of a mouse used for?
questions.option_d: Scrolling up and down long pages

questions.question_text: Which machine puts your digital document or photo onto a real sheet of paper?
During an online video class, which hardware captures your live face so others can see you?
During a voice call or recording, which part captures your voice into the computer?
Which pocket-sized device plugs into a USB port to carry files between home and school?
On a laptop, what is the flat touch-sensitive rectangle below the keyboard that works like a mouse?
Pressing the RIGHT button on a computer mouse usually opens what?
questions.option_b: A small shortcut/context menu with helpful options

questions.question_text: Which classroom device shines your computer screen onto a large white wall or board so the whole class can watch?
On a smartphone or tablet, the screen both shows pictures AND senses your finger taps. What is it called?
What Does "Hardware" mean in simple everyday words?
questions.option_b: The physical parts of a computer that you can actually see and touch

questions.question_text: In Indian homes and school labs, a small box called a UPS is connected to desktop PCs. Why is it useful?
questions.option_a: It provides short battery backup during a power cut so you can save your work safely

questions.question_text: What is the opposite of a Printer — a device that turns a paper certificate or drawing into a digital image file on your PC?
Which single modern cable carries BOTH sharp high-definition video AND audio from a laptop to a TV or projector?
At a supermarket checkout or school library, which handheld device reads black-and-white striped labels instantly?
Where do deleted files usually go FIRST on a Windows computer so you can recover them if needed?
Which simple built-in Windows app is used for freehand drawing and coloring with a mouse?
If you want to type a neat school essay or letter with headings and bullet points, which application is best?
To keep your school subjects organized on a computer, you put related files inside a yellow icon called a:
Which application is best for making visual slideshows to present a project in front of your class?
What do we call the main welcome screen with icons and wallpaper that appears after logging in to a PC?
Which popular free media player with an orange traffic-cone icon plays almost any video or audio file?
On an Android smartphone, which official app store is used to safely install apps?
Look at the file name "annual_day_photo.jpg". What kind of file is it?
Look at the file name "school_anthem.mp3". What kind of file is it?
Look at the file name "science_fair_demo.mp4". What kind of file is it?
What are the three small buttons ( — , □ , ✕ ) at the top-right corner of almost every Windows app window for?
questions.option_a: Minimize, Maximize, and Close the window

questions.question_text: Which popular design app/website lets students easily create posters, certificates, and invitations using ready templates?
What does "Software" mean in simple everyday language?
questions.option_a: The apps, programs, and operating system that run inside a computer or phone
questions.option_b: Soft cloth used to clean a monitor
questions.option_c: The power socket on the wall

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an Operating System (the core system software that runs a PC or phone)?
Why do schools send circulars and admit cards as a ".pdf" file instead of an editable Word file?
questions.option_a: PDFs do not take even 1 byte of space
questions.option_d: PDFs keep the exact layout, fonts, and alignment looking identical on every phone and computer

questions.question_text: Which application is best suited for keeping an attendance list, marks table, or club budget with automatic totals?
What is the difference between "Copy & Paste" and "Cut & Paste" on a file?
questions.option_b: Copy leaves the original file in place and makes a duplicate; Cut moves the file to the new folder

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a Web Browser used to open websites?
If you want to keep 3 websites open inside ONE browser window without opening 3 separate windows, what feature do you use?
questions.option_c: Browser Tabs (+ button at the top)

questions.question_text: What is a Search Engine (such as Google Search, Bing, or DuckDuckGo) used for?
questions.option_a: Finding websites, information, and answers on the internet using keywords

questions.question_text: In a web browser, clicking the circular arrow icon (⟳) near the address bar does what?
If you find a super useful study website and want to save it inside your browser for one-click access tomorrow, you add a:
When your mouse pointer turns from an arrow into a little pointing HAND over colored/underlined text on a webpage, it means:
questions.option_c: It is a clickable link (hyperlink) to another page or file

questions.question_text: Where do files you download from Chrome or Edge normally get saved on your computer by default?
In an email app like Gmail, what does the small PAPERCLIP (📎) button let you do?
questions.option_d: Attach a file, photo, or PDF to send along with your email

questions.question_text: What is the website address typed at the top of a browser (like `https://mapleskhatauli.com`) commonly called?
What does the Left Arrow (←) "Back" button at the top-left of a browser do?
questions.option_c: Takes you back to the previous webpage you were just viewing

questions.question_text: Look at an email address: `student@mapleskhatauli.com`. Which symbol always separates the username from the domain name?
What is that square black-and-white patterned box on posters or ID cards that opens a link when scanned with a phone camera?
Which of these is ALSO a popular web browser besides Google Chrome?
questions.option_b: Mozilla Firefox / Microsoft Edge / Apple Safari

questions.question_text: If you visited a helpful website yesterday and forgot its name, which browser list helps you find it again?
What is the real difference between Google Chrome and Google Search?
questions.option_c: Chrome is a search website; Google is a laptop brand
questions.option_d: Chrome is the Browser app installed on your device; Google Search is a website used inside a browser to look up info

questions.question_text: When you see `https://` and a padlock icon in the browser address bar before logging in, what does the "s" in `https` mean?
questions.option_d: Secure — data between your browser and the website is encrypted so others on Wi-Fi cannot read your password

questions.question_text: What does opening an "Incognito" or "Private" browser window ACTUALLY do on a shared computer?
questions.option_a: It gives free unlimited mobile data
questions.option_b: It stops the browser from saving your browsing history, cookies, and login session on THAT computer after you close the window
questions.option_c: It makes you completely invisible to websites and your internet provider
questions.option_d: It blocks all computer viruses automatically

questions.question_text: If a webpage shows "404 — Page Not Found", what does that simply mean?
questions.option_c: The specific link or page was moved, deleted, or typed with a spelling mistake

questions.question_text: Which wireless feature lets your phone or laptop connect to a home or school router without plugging in any wire?
Which short-range wireless feature is commonly used to connect wireless earbuds, speakers, or a wireless mouse?
If there is no Wi-Fi nearby and you share your mobile phone’s internet with your laptop, what phone feature do you turn ON?
What happens when you turn ON "Airplane Mode" on a smartphone or laptop?
questions.option_b: It turns off wireless radios like cellular network, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth

questions.question_text: What is the box with blinking lights at home or school that shares Wi-Fi internet with phones and computers?
In a school computer lab, many desktop PCs are plugged into internet wall sockets using a sturdy cable with a clip plug. What is that cable called?
On a mobile phone status bar, what do "4G" and "5G" indicate?
questions.option_a: How many gigabytes of storage are left
questions.option_d: Generations of mobile cellular network connectivity for internet and calls

questions.question_text: When you save a PDF circular FROM a school website ONTO your phone, is that called Downloading or Uploading?
When you select a photo FROM your computer and post/submit it TO an online portal, is that called Downloading or Uploading?
Look at the curved fan-shaped icon with 3 or 4 arcs in the corner of your phone or laptop screen. What does it show?
Which of these tasks works completely OFFLINE even when you have zero internet connection?
questions.option_a: Using the built-in Calculator or typing in Notepad

questions.question_text: Why do home and school Wi-Fi networks have a password?
questions.option_a: Because routers cannot turn on without a 20-letter name
questions.option_b: So strangers outside cannot use your internet or access devices on your network
questions.option_d: To make the router light turn blue

questions.question_text: When a YouTube video pauses with a spinning circle in the middle because the internet is slow, what is that called?
Roughly how far does normal Bluetooth (like wireless earbuds connected to your phone) usually reach clearly?
questions.option_d: A short room-size distance (around 10 meters / 30 feet)

questions.question_text: Your laptop says "Connected to Wi-Fi, No Internet." What does this message actually mean?
questions.option_a: Your laptop Wi-Fi card is broken
questions.option_d: Your laptop is connected to the Wi-Fi router in the room, but the router’s outside internet line is down

questions.question_text: Why are desktop computers in an exam lab often connected by Ethernet (LAN) cables instead of Wi-Fi?
questions.option_a: LAN cables also power the monitor without electricity
questions.option_b: A wired Ethernet cable gives steadier, interference-free internet for 30+ PCs at the same time
questions.option_c: Desktop PCs can never use Wi-Fi

questions.question_text: Internet plan speeds from providers like JioFiber, Airtel, or BSNL are commonly advertised in "100 Mbps". What does Mbps measure?
questions.option_a: How far the Wi-Fi reaches in meters
questions.option_b: How many months the plan lasts
questions.option_c: Megabits per second — how fast data transfers over your internet connection

questions.question_text: Companies like BSNL, Airtel, Jio, or local fiber broadband providers that connect homes/schools to the internet are called:
If a stranger calls claiming to be from a bank or school and asks for the 6-digit OTP on your phone, what should you ALWAYS do?
questions.option_a: NEVER share the OTP with anyone — hang up and tell a parent or teacher
questions.option_b: Send a screenshot of the OTP

questions.question_text: Before posting a funny photo or video of your classmate on social media, what is the right social ethic to follow?
questions.option_a: Always ask your classmate’s clear permission first, and respect it if they say no

questions.question_text: When you finish using a shared computer in the school computer lab, what should you ALWAYS do before leaving your seat?
questions.option_a: Leave your email and portal logged in for the next class
questions.option_b: Log out of your account and close your browser session cleanly

questions.question_text: Which of these is the STRONGEST and safest password?
In online group chats or comments, typing an entire message IN ALL CAPITAL LETTERS LIKE THIS is usually read as:
If a junior student asks a very basic computer question in the tech club, how should a good member respond?
questions.option_a: Laugh at them in front of the group
questions.option_d: Explain it patiently and kindly — everyone starts as a beginner!

questions.question_text: If someone repeatedly sends mean, hurtful, or threatening messages to a classmate online, what is that harmful behavior called?
questions.option_b: Cyberbullying (which must be reported to parents/teachers, never joined!)

questions.question_text: You receive a dramatic WhatsApp forward saying "Tomorrow is a sudden holiday — forward to 20 friends!" What is the smart, responsible step?
questions.option_c: Do NOT forward blindly — verify first from the official school notice or teacher

questions.question_text: Why shouldn’t you eat sticky snacks or keep an open cup of water right over a computer keyboard?
questions.option_a: Crumbs and spilled liquid can permanently short-circuit and ruin the keyboard or laptop

questions.question_text: If a pop-up flashes on screen: "🎉 CONGRATULATIONS! You won a free iPhone! Click here & enter your details!", what is it almost certainly?
questions.option_a: A scam / phishing trap trying to steal personal details or install malware — close it immediately!
questions.option_b: A real gift from your browser

questions.question_text: What is "Netiquette"?
questions.option_b: Good manners, kindness, and respectful behavior when communicating on the internet

questions.question_text: Should you share your home address, school timetable, and phone number publicly with unknown strangers in online game chats?
questions.option_a: Yes, if they have a cool profile picture
questions.option_b: Yes, on every public comment section
questions.option_c: No — keep personal details private to stay safe online
questions.option_d: Yes, if they offer free game coins

questions.question_text: When you use a diagram, photo, or quote created by someone else in your school presentation, what is the honest thing to do?
questions.option_b: Forbid anyone else from seeing the source
questions.option_c: Crop out their name and claim it as yours
questions.option_d: Give clear credit to the original creator or source instead of pretending you made it yourself

questions.question_text: To keep your eyes comfortable while studying or working on a computer, what does the healthy "20-20-20 Rule" recommend?
questions.option_a: Sit 20 millimeters from the screen for 20 hours
questions.option_d: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax your eyes

questions.question_text: Important UPI Safety Rule in India: Do you EVER need to enter your secret UPI PIN to RECEIVE money from someone?
questions.option_a: Yes, scanning any QR code automatically credits money after PIN
questions.option_b: NEVER! A UPI PIN is ONLY entered when money is GOING OUT from your account — asking you to enter PIN to "receive" money is a scam!
questions.option_c: Yes, you must enter UPI PIN to receive gifts
questions.option_d: UPI PIN is just your roll number

questions.question_text: What is "Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)" on email or social accounts, and why is it great?
questions.option_a: It deletes your account after two days
questions.option_b: It forces two friends to share one account
questions.option_c: It adds a second check (like a code on your phone) besides your password, so thieves can’t break in with a leaked password alone
questions.option_d: It slows down typing speed by half

questions.question_text: Why is reusing the EXACT SAME password across 10 different games, websites, and your main email risky?
questions.option_a: If even one small game site gets hacked, attackers immediately try that same password on your email and other accounts!
questions.option_b: It uses extra storage on your phone

questions.question_text: How should a responsible student use AI tools (like ChatGPT or Gemini) when working on a project or assignment?
questions.option_a: Use AI to brainstorm, understand tough ideas, or debug — then write/build in your own understanding and honestly mention where AI helped
questions.option_b: Copy-paste the entire AI output without reading a word and sign it as 100% your own
questions.option_c: Trust every single date or quote from AI without checking
